stem.text: Steel pellets, each with a mass of $0.60\,\text{g}$, fall vertically onto a horizontal plate at a rate of 100 pellets per minute. They strike the plate with a velocity of $5.0\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ and rebound with a velocity of $4.0\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
What is the average force exerted on the plate by the pellets?
